policy.reinvestment: A trip's comp budget is a share of the player's trip theoretical (ADT x days): 40% for X, 35% for Icon, 30% for Legend. The host may offer each item up to its limit and the whole trip up to the budget.
policy.approval: Anything above an item's limit, above the trip budget, or not on the player's list needs approval from the Casino Marketing shift manager. The host asks; the agent never promises it.
policy.free_play: Free play is never offered to a player with a responsible-gaming note or a voluntary play limit on file.
policy.tickets: Show tickets come from the host allocation for Hard Rock Live; the limit is per trip.
